data.message: I keep my 18-ton commitment even if others take 10. Fisher07: your ≤450 condition is noted; would you choose 18 even if others choose 10? Please clarify. Each 10-ton chooser: reconsider 18 for $8,000 extra if fulfilled, or confirm 10. Weak recovery requires lower future catches; half-stock preserves stock, not always full recovery.
